name: nib holdings limited
summary: nib holdings limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the underwriting and distribution of private health, life, and living insurance to residents, international students, and visitors in Australia and New Zealand. The company operates in six segments: Australian Residents Health Insurance, International (Inbound) Health Insurance, New Zealand Insurance, nib Travel, nib Thrive, and nib Health Services. It also offers travel and disability insurance products. In addition, the company provides health and wellbeing, telehealth, and treatment delivery services, as well as health management programs.
